Topic 3.3: Capacity (how

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Capacity (how. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how many more or less?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. fill and empty different 10 lessons seeds or sand
2. compare sizes of containers using water, sand or seeds how much a container can hold compared to another one of a different size. emptying containers. containers of different sizes.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. fill and empty different 10 lessons seeds or sand
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to fill and empty different 10 lessons seeds or sand. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. compare sizes of containers using water, sand or seeds how much a container can hold compared to another one of a different size. emptying containers. containers of different sizes.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to compare sizes of containers using water, sand or seeds how much a container can hold compared to another one of a different size. emptying containers. containers of different sizes. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Capacity (how.
2. Explain Capacity (how to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Capacity (how.
4. Show that you can: fill and empty different 10 lessons seeds or sand
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Capacity (how. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how many more or less?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. fill and empty different 10 lessons seeds or sand
2. compare sizes of containers using water, sand or seeds how much a container can hold compared to another one of a different size. emptying containers. containers of different sizes.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
